decision.summary: Two regions stand out: (1) an abrupt U-offset starting near index 490 with persistent low U and correlated N/E motion; (2) a large, rapid uplift event in U (~+9 units) centered near index 612, with strong cross-axis coupling and no full return observed in the window.

regions.observation: Cross-axis shape shows a multi-sample abrupt shift in U (downward) around index ~490, followed by a sustained platform in U at lower values; N and E show correlated but noisier fluctuations without clear opposing return. The shift is abrupt over 2–3 samples and persists through the window end.

Strong, coherent upward jump in U (from ~-2 to ~+7) between indices ~610–615, accompanied by large simultaneous shifts in N and E; the new level holds for ~30 samples before possible subtle drift. No clear return observed within window, though later samples suggest possible partial reversal beginning near index ~650.
